              LM74700-Q1 Low IQ Reverse Battery Protection Ideal Diode Controller

1 Features                                                                  3 Description
•   AEC-Q100 qualified with the following results                           The LM74700-Q1 is an automotive AEC Q100
    – Device temperature grade 1:                                           qualified ideal diode controller which operates in
       –40°C to +125°C ambient operating                                    conjunction with an external N-channel MOSFET as
       temperature range                                                    an ideal diode rectifier for low loss reverse polarity
    – Device HBM ESD classification level 2                                 protection with a 20-mV forward voltage drop. The
    – Device CDM ESD classification level C4B                               wide supply input range of 3.2 V to 65 V allows control
                                                                            of many popular DC bus voltages such as 12-V, 24-V
•   Functional Safety-Capable
                                                                            and 48-V automotive battery systems. The 3.2-V input
    – Documentation available to aid functional safety                      voltage support is particularly well suited for severe
       system design                                                        cold crank requirements in automotive systems. The
•   3.2-V to 65-V input range (3.9-V start up)                              device can withstand and protect the loads from
•   –65-V reverse voltage rating                                            negative supply voltages down to –65 V.
•   Charge pump for external N-Channel MOSFET
                                                                            The device controls the GATE of the MOSFET to
•   20-mV ANODE to CATHODE forward voltage drop                             regulate the forward voltage drop at 20 mV. The
    regulation                                                              regulation scheme enables graceful turn off of the
•   Enable pin feature                                                      MOSFET during a reverse current event and ensures
•   1-µA shutdown current (EN=Low)                                          zero DC reverse current flow. Fast response (< 0.75
•   80-µA operating quiescent current (EN=High)                             µs) to Reverse Current Blocking makes the device
•   2.3-A peak gate turnoff current                                         suitable for systems with output voltage holdup
•   Fast response to reverse current blocking:                              requirements during ISO7637 pulse testing as well as
    < 0.75 µs                                                               power fail and input micro-short conditions.
•   Meets automotive ISO7637 transient requirements                         The LM74700-Q1 controller provides a charge pump
    with a suitable TVS Diode                                               gate drive for an external N-channel MOSFET. The
•   Available in 6-pin and 8-pin SOT-23 Package 2.90                        high voltage rating of LM74700-Q1 helps to simplify
    mm × 1.60 mm                                                            the system designs for automotive ISO7637
                                                                            protection. With the enable pin low, the controller is off
2 Applications                                                              and draws approximately 1 µA of current.
